faq_1.q: How does Thikana verify rental properties in Khulna?
faq_1.a: Every listing on Thikana undergoes a strict verification pipeline. We confirm the landlord's national identity, phone number, property ownership/manager status, physical location coordinates, and up-to-date utility bills before issuing the verified checkmark badge.

faq_2.q: Are there any hidden brokerage or middleman fees?
faq_2.a: Zero hidden fees. Thikana connects tenants directly with verified homeowners and registered mess managers. You deal transparently without paying arbitrary third-party broker cuts.

faq_3.q: How do university students get prioritized rental access?
faq_3.a: Students from KUET, Khulna University, BL College, and KMC can verify their student institutional email or student ID. This unlocks exclusive verified mess rooms and discounted advance deposit terms.

faq_4.q: What is the Three-Property Comparison tool?
faq_4.a: You can pin up to three properties side-by-side to compare advance deposits, square footage, monthly utility rules, gas cylinder vs pipeline, WiFi speed, and landlord restrictions in a single unified table.

faq_5.q: How can a landlord in Khulna list their home?
faq_5.a: Landlords can register for free, upload high-resolution photos, specify rooms and amenities, and instantly begin receiving verified visit requests through their dedicated landlord portal.
